summary: The LanguageSwitcher is a user control component implemented for handling language switching functionality in a web application. It leverages ASP.NET web controls to toggle between locales and update the page URL accordingly.
purpose: To manage language switching by toggling between different locale settings on a web page and redirecting users with the updated locale in the URL.

fields.name: UserSession
fields.description: Stores session-related information including locale details.

fields.name: lbLanguageSwitcher
fields.description: A web control that initiates the language change event.

workflows.name: Language Switch
steps: User clicks the language switcher link button.
Check if the current locale is available in the URL; if not, append the current locale.
Toggle the locale parameter to the alternate locale.
If the page requested is not 'DEFAULT', add a URL hash for security.
Redirect to the updated URL with the new locale.

business_rules.description: If the locale is not present in the URL, it will default to the session's current locale.

conditions.description: Check if the locale in the URL is empty to append the current locale.
Determine which locale to toggle based on the session's current state.

system_behavior: Redirects the user to the same page with an updated locale query string parameter.

dependencies.description: Uses HSPnetSession for managing session data such as locale.
Utilizes Hashing.AddURLHash to ensure URL integrity.
